name: Sovereign ERP
tagline: A ledger and period-close kernel whose rules are checked by model checking and formal specifications.

highlights.title: Period close as a checked state machine
highlights.text: The Period Controller decides close, reopen and adjustment moves, and its invariants are checked against a TLA+ specification in lockstep.

highlights.title: An engine-neutral ledger
highlights.text: A Ledger Port interface with a conformance suite that any ledger engine adapter has to pass.

highlights.title: Seeded defects are caught
highlights.text: Deliberately broken variants are run against the checks, and each one is caught with its shortest counterexample.

verifyIt: Try to close, reopen and adjust an accounting period, then switch on a seeded defect and read the shortest counterexample the checker finds.

demo.title: Close a period
demo.summary: Drive the Period Controller and watch the invariants refuse illegal moves.
demo.sample: a small ledger and period calendar
